critical_code_review_comments: PresentationContext scroll handler can briefly set index back to the previous slide during in-flight smooth scroll, causing the counter to lag by ~1-2s before catching up. Counter eventually reaches the correct value; UX-wise consider suppressing the scroll-handler updates for ~600ms after a programmatic goTo() to avoid flicker.

HeroQRCard hardcodes window.location.origin + '/' — fine for current single-route prototype, but if /proposta were ever shared via QR the user would always be sent back to /. Consider using current pathname or accepting a 'url' prop.

PageActionsHeader hides export-pdf and present-toggle via 'sm:inline-flex' (hidden < sm). This is intentional per spec but means mobile users coming via QR code will not see PDF export — confirmed not a bug, just a note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 added /proposta route, presentation mode (4 sections on /, 6 on /proposta), one-click PDF export (jsPDF+html2canvas, real download) and hero QR code with copy-to-clipboard. All features verified end-to-end at desktop viewport (1920x1080). Clipboard tests require granting clipboard-read/write permissions via page.context.grant_permissions. Presentation counter updates take ~2-3s after a navigation (smooth scroll + scroll-position handler), so use waits >=3s before asserting counter changes. PDF export takes ~5-10s on /proposta — use download listener with 60s timeout. The earlier iteration_1 regression for /checkout was not re-tested in depth per the request (spot-check only).
